variables.name: story_key
variables.label: Story key
variables.description: Stable key for the story: a keyed hash (HMAC) of its URL slug, using a secret that stays on the collecting computer. Records match across reruns, but the key cannot be traced back to a story URL.

variables.name: queue_category_slug
variables.label: Sampling category
variables.description: The category listing the story was sampled from (its sampling stratum). Almost always equal to category_slug.

variables.name: category_slug
variables.label: Category (slug)
variables.description: Literotica's own category for the story, as given on the story page (URL form, e.g. adult-romance).
variables.caveat: Falls back to the category of the listing page the story was found on if the story page does not name one.

variables.name: category_name
variables.label: Category
variables.description: Literotica's own name for the story's category (e.g. Romance), taken from the site's category list for category_slug, so every story in a category has the same name.

variables.name: category_source
variables.label: Category source
variables.description: Where the category came from: 'page' (the story page) or 'listing' (the category listing it was found on).

variables.name: sampling_weight
variables.label: Sampling weight
variables.description: Estimated number of stories in the category divided by the number of analysed stories from that category. Use it to weight 'All categories' summaries so large categories count in proportion to their size.
variables.caveat: Blank when the category's size could not be estimated from its listing pages.

variables.name: date_published
variables.label: Publication date
variables.description: Date the story was published (Literotica's approval date).
variables.caveat: Not included in the Stage 2 handoff (year, month and weekday are).

variables.name: pub_year
variables.label: Publication year
variables.description: Year the story was published.

variables.name: pub_month
variables.label: Publication month
variables.description: Month the story was published.

variables.name: pub_weekday
variables.label: Publication weekday
variables.description: Day of the week the story was published.

variables.name: pub_is_weekend
variables.label: Published on a weekend
variables.description: Whether the story was published on a Saturday or Sunday.

variables.name: age_days
variables.label: Days online
variables.description: Days between publication and the moment its statistics were recorded by the collector.
variables.caveat: Measured at collection time; stories collected on different days have slightly different reference dates.

variables.name: age_years
variables.label: Years online
variables.description: age_days divided by 365.25.

variables.name: pop_views
variables.label: Views
variables.description: Number of views shown for the story.
variables.caveat: A running total as displayed by Literotica when the story was collected. Older stories have had more time to accumulate it; compare with the per-month version. Rounded to 3 significant figures in the Stage 2 handoff.

variables.name: pop_views_approx
variables.label: Views abbreviated
variables.description: True when only an abbreviated count (e.g. '12.3k') was available, so views are rounded.

variables.name: pop_favorites
variables.label: Favorites
variables.description: Number of readers who added the story to their favorites.
variables.caveat: A running total as displayed by Literotica when the story was collected. Older stories have had more time to accumulate it; compare with the per-month version. Rounded to 3 significant figures in the Stage 2 handoff.

variables.name: pop_comments
variables.label: Comments
variables.description: Number of public comments on the story.
variables.caveat: A running total as displayed by Literotica when the story was collected. Older stories have had more time to accumulate it; compare with the per-month version. Rounded to 3 significant figures in the Stage 2 handoff.

variables.name: pop_rating
variables.label: Average rating
variables.description: Average star rating (1–5) shown for the story.
variables.caveat: Blank when the story had no ratings yet. Readers who vote are a small, self-selected group.

variables.name: pop_rating_count
variables.label: Number of ratings
variables.description: Number of readers who rated the story, from the story page's own data (not always shown on screen).
variables.caveat: A running total as displayed by Literotica when the story was collected. Older stories have had more time to accumulate it; compare with the per-month version. Readers who vote are a small, self-selected group. Rounded to 3 significant figures in the Stage 2 handoff.

variables.name: pop_reading_lists
variables.label: Reading-list adds
variables.description: Number of times the story was added to readers' reading lists, when shown.
variables.caveat: A running total as displayed by Literotica when the story was collected. Older stories have had more time to accumulate it; compare with the per-month version. Rounded to 3 significant figures in the Stage 2 handoff.

variables.name: pop_log10_views
variables.label: Views (log scale)
variables.description: Base-10 logarithm of views + 1; useful because view counts span several orders of magnitude.

variables.name: pop_fav_per_1k_views
variables.label: Favorites per 1,000 views
variables.description: Favorites divided by views, times 1,000: how often a reader who opened the story favorited it.
variables.caveat: Only computed when the story has at least the configured minimum number of views (default 100).

variables.name: pop_comments_per_1k_views
variables.label: Comments per 1,000 views
variables.description: Comments divided by views, times 1,000.
variables.caveat: Only computed when the story has at least the configured minimum number of views (default 100).

variables.name: pop_ratings_per_1k_views
variables.label: Ratings per 1,000 views
variables.description: Number of ratings divided by views, times 1,000 (only when the number of ratings is available).
variables.caveat: Only computed when the story has at least the configured minimum number of views (default 100).

variables.name: pop_reading_lists_per_1k_views
variables.label: Reading-list adds per 1,000 views
variables.description: Reading-list adds divided by views, times 1,000.
variables.caveat: Only computed when the story has at least the configured minimum number of views (default 100).

variables.name: pop_views_per_month
variables.label: Views per month
variables.description: Views divided by the number of months the story had been online when collected.
variables.caveat: Total divided by months online (minimum one month). A simple descriptive adjustment, not a statistical correction: views are not spread evenly over a story's life.

variables.name: pop_favorites_per_month
variables.label: Favorites per month
variables.description: Favorites divided by months online.
variables.caveat: Total divided by months online (minimum one month). A simple descriptive adjustment, not a statistical correction: views are not spread evenly over a story's life.

variables.name: pop_comments_per_month
variables.label: Comments per month
variables.description: Comments divided by months online.
variables.caveat: Total divided by months online (minimum one month). A simple descriptive adjustment, not a statistical correction: views are not spread evenly over a story's life.

variables.name: pop_is_hot
variables.label: 'Hot' badge
variables.description: Literotica's 'H' (hot) badge, shown for highly rated stories.

variables.name: pop_writers_pick
variables.label: Writer's pick
variables.description: Literotica's Writer's Pick badge.

variables.name: pop_contest_winner
variables.label: Contest winner
variables.description: Story won a Literotica contest.

variables.name: site_words_count
variables.label: Word count (site)
variables.description: Literotica's own word count for the story, when shown.

variables.name: story_pages
variables.label: Pages on site
variables.description: Number of web pages the story is split into.

variables.name: meta_tag_count
variables.label: Number of tags
variables.description: Number of tags the author attached.

variables.name: author_stories_count
variables.label: Author's story count
variables.description: Number of stories the author had published (public profile count) when collected.
variables.caveat: Measured at collection time, not at publication time. In the Stage 2 handoff rounded down to bands (1, 2, 6, 21, 51, 101, 201+).

variables.name: author_followers_count
variables.label: Author's followers
variables.description: Number of followers the author had (public profile count) when collected.
variables.caveat: Measured at collection time, so it partly reflects the author's later success. In the Stage 2 handoff rounded down to bands (0, 10, 100, 1,000, 10,000+).

variables.name: story_words
variables.label: Word count
variables.description: Number of words in the story text (letters/digits, contractions count as one word). Author's notes, headings and other paratext are not counted (see Methodology).
variables.caveat: Counted on the collected pages; long stories beyond the page cap are flagged as truncated. Blank when the collected text is incomplete (text_truncated). Use site_words_count for length then.

variables.name: story_chars
variables.label: Character count
variables.description: Number of characters in the story text (paratext excluded).
variables.caveat: Blank when the collected text is incomplete (text_truncated).

variables.name: story_sentences
variables.label: Sentence count
variables.description: Number of sentences (see Methodology).
variables.caveat: Blank when the collected text is incomplete (text_truncated).

variables.name: story_paragraphs
variables.label: Paragraph count
variables.description: Number of non-empty story paragraphs (paratext excluded).
variables.caveat: Blank when the collected text is incomplete (text_truncated).

variables.name: story_mean_sentence_words
variables.label: Average sentence length
variables.description: Average number of words per sentence.

variables.name: story_median_sentence_words
variables.label: Median sentence length
variables.description: Median number of words per sentence.

variables.name: story_mean_paragraph_words
variables.label: Average paragraph length
variables.description: Average number of words per paragraph.

variables.name: story_median_paragraph_words
variables.label: Median paragraph length
variables.description: Median number of words per paragraph.

variables.name: story_one_sentence_paragraph_share
variables.label: One-sentence paragraphs
variables.description: Share of paragraphs that consist of a single sentence.

variables.name: story_long_paragraph_share
variables.label: Very long paragraphs ('walls of text')
variables.description: Share of paragraphs longer than 150 words.

variables.name: story_scene_breaks
variables.label: Scene breaks
variables.description: Number of scene-break lines inside the story: paragraphs with no letters or digits ('* * *', '-----', '......', 'o0o'). Lines that open or close the story are not counted.
variables.caveat: Blank when the collected text is incomplete (text_truncated).

variables.name: story_scene_breaks_per_1k
variables.label: Scene breaks per 1,000 words
variables.description: Scene-break lines per 1,000 words.

variables.name: story_has_author_note
variables.label: Has an author's note
variables.description: Whether the story opens or closes with an author's or editor's note, disclaimer, dedication, copyright line or words to readers, or has a paragraph labelled as an author's note (see Methodology, 'Paratext').
variables.caveat: Rule-based; misses notes that use no recognisable wording (about 1 in 3 in a hand check). Blank when the collected text is incomplete (text_truncated).

variables.name: story_requests_feedback
variables.label: Asks readers to vote or comment
variables.description: Whether the author's notes, or the first or last three story paragraphs, ask readers to vote, rate, comment or give feedback.
variables.caveat: Blank when the collected text is incomplete (text_truncated).

variables.name: title_chars
variables.label: Title length
variables.description: Number of characters in the title.

variables.name: title_words
variables.label: Title word count
variables.description: Number of words in the title.

variables.name: title_has_chapter_marker
variables.label: Title marks a chapter/part
variables.description: Whether the title contains a chapter or part marker such as 'Ch. 02', 'Pt. 3' or ends with a number.

variables.name: desc_chars
variables.label: Description length
variables.description: Number of characters in the author's short description.

variables.name: desc_words
variables.label: Description word count
variables.description: Number of words in the description.

variables.name: series_is_part
variables.label: Part of a series
variables.description: Whether the story belongs to a series (series link on the page, a series of 2+ parts, or a chapter marker in the title).

variables.name: series_part_number
variables.label: Part number
variables.description: Which part of its series the story is (1 = first), from the series list or the title.

variables.name: series_parts_count
variables.label: Parts in series
variables.description: Number of parts in the series, when shown.

variables.name: series_is_later_part
variables.label: Later part of a series
variables.description: Whether the story is part 2 or later of a series.

variables.name: pov_first_singular_per_1k
variables.label: I / me / my
variables.description: First-person singular pronouns (I, me, my, mine, myself, I'm …) per 1,000 words, dialogue included.

variables.name: pov_first_plural_per_1k
variables.label: We / us / our
variables.description: First-person plural pronouns per 1,000 words.

variables.name: pov_second_per_1k
variables.label: You / your
variables.description: Second-person pronouns per 1,000 words.

variables.name: pov_third_per_1k
variables.label: He / she / they
variables.description: Third-person personal pronouns (he, she, they and their forms) per 1,000 words.

variables.name: pov_first_singular_narr_per_1k
variables.label: I / me / my in narration
variables.description: First-person singular pronouns per 1,000 words of narration (outside quotation marks).

variables.name: pov_second_narr_per_1k
variables.label: You / your in narration
variables.description: Second-person pronouns per 1,000 narration words.

variables.name: pov_third_narr_per_1k
variables.label: He / she / they in narration
variables.description: Third-person pronouns per 1,000 narration words.

variables.name: pov_first_person_share
variables.label: First-person share of pronouns
variables.description: In narration, first-person pronouns as a share of first- plus third-person pronouns.
variables.caveat: A word-counting heuristic, not true narrative analysis; see Methodology for how it was validated.

variables.name: pov_class
variables.label: Narrative perspective
variables.description: Estimated narrative perspective from narration pronouns: first if ≥15 I/me/my per 1,000 narration words; second if 'you' forms are ≥15 and more frequent; third if under 5; otherwise mixed; unknown if under 200 narration words.
variables.caveat: A word-counting heuristic, not true narrative analysis; see Methodology for how it was validated.

variables.name: pov_is_first_person
variables.label: First-person narration
variables.description: 1 for stories classified as first person, 0 for third person, blank otherwise.
variables.caveat: A word-counting heuristic, not true narrative analysis; see Methodology for how it was validated.

variables.name: narr_present_tense_share
variables.label: Present-tense share
variables.description: In narration, present-tense forms of ~70 common verbs as a share of present plus past forms.
variables.caveat: Blank if fewer than 20 such verbs occur. A heuristic.

variables.name: narr_tense_class
variables.label: Narration tense
variables.description: Present if the present-tense share is ≥ 0.6, past if ≤ 0.4, otherwise mixed.

variables.name: narr_is_present_tense
variables.label: Present-tense narration
variables.description: 1 for present-tense narration, 0 for past tense, blank otherwise.

variables.name: dlg_word_share
variables.label: Dialogue share
variables.description: Share of words inside quotation marks.
variables.caveat: Depends on consistent quotation marks; stories using none score 0 even if they contain speech.

variables.name: dlg_segments
variables.label: Dialogue segments
variables.description: Number of separate quoted passages.
variables.caveat: Blank when the collected text is incomplete (text_truncated).

variables.name: dlg_segments_per_1k
variables.label: Dialogue segments per 1,000 words
variables.description: Number of separate quoted passages per 1,000 words.

variables.name: dlg_mean_segment_words
variables.label: Average speech length
variables.description: Average number of words per quoted passage.

variables.name: dlg_question_share
variables.label: Questions asked in dialogue
variables.description: Share of all question marks that occur inside quotation marks.

variables.name: dlg_exclamation_share
variables.label: Exclamations in dialogue
variables.description: Share of all exclamation marks that occur inside quotation marks.

variables.name: dlg_paragraph_share
variables.label: Paragraphs with dialogue
variables.description: Share of paragraphs that contain at least one quoted passage.

variables.name: dlg_has_dialogue
variables.label: Has dialogue
variables.description: Whether the story has any quoted speech.

variables.name: char_recurring_names
variables.label: Recurring names
variables.description: Number of distinct capitalised names that appear at least 3 times mid-sentence (mostly characters, sometimes places).
variables.caveat: Heuristic: first names and surnames count separately; place and brand names can be included; names that only ever start a sentence are missed. Blank when the collected text is incomplete (text_truncated).

variables.name: char_name_mentions_per_1k
variables.label: Name mentions per 1,000 words
variables.description: Mentions of those recurring names per 1,000 words.

variables.name: char_top_name_share
variables.label: Focus on main name
variables.description: Share of all name mentions taken by the most-mentioned name.

variables.name: gender_masculine_per_1k
variables.label: He / him / his
variables.description: Masculine pronouns per 1,000 words.
variables.caveat: Pronouns describe the characters on the page, not the author; first-person narrators' gender is invisible to this measure.

variables.name: gender_feminine_per_1k
variables.label: She / her / hers
variables.description: Feminine pronouns per 1,000 words.
variables.caveat: Pronouns describe the characters on the page, not the author; first-person narrators' gender is invisible to this measure.

variables.name: gender_neutral_plural_per_1k
variables.label: They / them / their
variables.description: They/them/their pronouns per 1,000 words (plural or singular).
variables.caveat: Pronouns describe the characters on the page, not the author; first-person narrators' gender is invisible to this measure.

variables.name: gender_feminine_share
variables.label: Feminine share of he/she pronouns
variables.description: Feminine pronouns as a share of feminine plus masculine pronouns.
variables.caveat: Pronouns describe the characters on the page, not the author; first-person narrators' gender is invisible to this measure.

variables.name: gender_composition
variables.label: Pronoun composition
variables.description: Mostly feminine if the feminine share is ≥ 0.65, mostly masculine if ≤ 0.35, few if under 5 gendered pronouns per 1,000 words.
variables.caveat: Pronouns describe the characters on the page, not the author; first-person narrators' gender is invisible to this measure.

variables.name: punct_exclamation_per_1k
variables.label: Exclamation marks
variables.description: Exclamation marks per 1,000 words.

variables.name: punct_question_per_1k
variables.label: Question marks
variables.description: Question marks per 1,000 words.

variables.name: punct_ellipsis_per_1k
variables.label: Ellipses
variables.description: Ellipses ('…' or '...') per 1,000 words. Lines made only of dots are scene breaks, not ellipses.

variables.name: punct_dash_per_1k
variables.label: Dashes
variables.description: Dashes per 1,000 words: em dashes ('—'), runs of hyphens ('--'), and a hyphen or en dash with a space on each side used as a dash ('she paused - then left'). Hyphens inside words are not dashes.

variables.name: punct_semicolon_per_1k
variables.label: Semicolons
variables.description: Semicolons per 1,000 words.

variables.name: punct_colon_per_1k
variables.label: Colons
variables.description: Colons per 1,000 words.

variables.name: punct_comma_per_1k
variables.label: Commas
variables.description: Commas per 1,000 words.

variables.name: punct_quote_marks_per_1k
variables.label: Quotation marks
variables.description: Double quotation marks per 1,000 words.

variables.name: punct_parentheses_per_1k
variables.label: Parentheses
variables.description: Opening parentheses per 1,000 words.

variables.name: punct_repeated_per_1k
variables.label: Repeated punctuation (!!, ?!)
variables.description: Runs of two or more ! or ? marks (e.g. '!!', '?!') per 1,000 words.

variables.name: qe_question_sentence_share
variables.label: Question sentences
variables.description: Share of sentences that end with a question mark.

variables.name: qe_exclamation_sentence_share
variables.label: Exclamation sentences
variables.description: Share of sentences that end with an exclamation mark.

variables.name: qe_question_sentences_per_1k
variables.label: Questions per 1,000 words
variables.description: Sentences ending in a question mark per 1,000 words.

variables.name: qe_exclamation_sentences_per_1k
variables.label: Exclamations per 1,000 words
variables.description: Sentences ending in an exclamation mark per 1,000 words.

variables.name: qe_question_to_statement_ratio
variables.label: Questions per statement
variables.description: Question sentences divided by statements (sentences not ending in ? or !).

variables.name: read_mean_word_chars
variables.label: Average word length
variables.description: Average number of letters per word.

variables.name: read_mean_syllables_per_word
variables.label: Syllables per word
variables.description: Average estimated syllables per word.
variables.caveat: Syllables are estimated with a spelling rule (~85–90% exact per word).

variables.name: read_polysyllable_share
variables.label: Long (3+ syllable) words
variables.description: Share of words with three or more syllables.

variables.name: read_flesch_reading_ease
variables.label: Reading ease (Flesch)
variables.description: Flesch Reading Ease: 206.835 − 1.015 × words/sentence − 84.6 × syllables/word. Higher is easier.
variables.caveat: Dialogue-heavy text has short sentences and scores as easy.

variables.name: read_flesch_kincaid_grade
variables.label: Grade level (Flesch–Kincaid)
variables.description: Flesch–Kincaid grade: 0.39 × words/sentence + 11.8 × syllables/word − 15.59.

variables.name: read_ari
variables.label: Grade level (ARI)
variables.description: Automated Readability Index: 4.71 × letters/word + 0.5 × words/sentence − 21.43.

variables.name: read_coleman_liau
variables.label: Grade level (Coleman–Liau)
variables.description: Coleman–Liau index from letters per 100 words and sentences per 100 words.

variables.name: read_gunning_fog
variables.label: Fog index
variables.description: Gunning Fog index: 0.4 × (words/sentence + 100 × share of 3+ syllable words).

variables.name: read_grade_composite
variables.label: Reading difficulty (grade)
variables.description: Average of the Flesch–Kincaid, ARI and Coleman–Liau grade levels: a single 'estimated school grade'.

variables.name: syn_commas_per_sentence
variables.label: Commas per sentence
variables.description: Average number of commas per sentence (a rough sign of longer, multi-part sentences).

variables.name: syn_subordinators_per_sentence
variables.label: Subordinate clauses per sentence
variables.description: Words that usually start a dependent clause (because, although, which, when…) per sentence.

variables.name: syn_long_sentence_share
variables.label: Long sentences (>30 words)
variables.description: Share of sentences longer than 30 words.

variables.name: syn_short_sentence_share
variables.label: Short sentences (≤5 words)
variables.description: Share of sentences of five words or fewer.

variables.name: syn_sentence_length_sd
variables.label: Sentence-length variety
variables.description: Standard deviation of sentence length: how much sentence lengths vary.

variables.name: lex_unique_words
variables.label: Unique words
variables.description: Number of different words used.
variables.caveat: Grows with story length; compare stories of similar length or use the moving-average measure. Blank when the collected text is incomplete (text_truncated).

variables.name: lex_ttr
variables.label: Type–token ratio
variables.description: Unique words divided by total words.
variables.caveat: Strongly depends on length (longer texts always score lower); prefer lex_mattr. Blank when the collected text is incomplete (text_truncated).

variables.name: lex_mattr
variables.label: Vocabulary variety (moving average)
variables.description: Moving-average type–token ratio: the share of different words in every 500-word window, averaged.
variables.caveat: Needs at least 500 words (window size); blank for shorter stories.

variables.name: lex_segment_ttr
variables.label: Vocabulary variety (per 1,000 words)
variables.description: Average share of different words within consecutive 1,000-word segments.
variables.caveat: Blank for stories under 1,000 words.

variables.name: lex_mean_word_zipf
variables.label: Everyday vocabulary
variables.description: Average commonness of the words used, on the Zipf scale from the wordfreq English word-frequency list (about 7 = 'the', 3 = rare).

variables.name: lex_rare_word_share
variables.label: Rare words
variables.description: Share of words that are rare in English (Zipf below 3, under ~1 per million words).

variables.name: lex_unrecognized_word_share
variables.label: Unrecognised words
variables.description: Share of words not in the English frequency list: names, invented words, typos or non-English words.
variables.caveat: Not a spelling-error rate: names and slang count too.

variables.name: lex_long_word_share
variables.label: Long words (7+ letters)
variables.description: Share of words with seven or more letters.

variables.name: rep_top10_content_share
variables.label: Focus on a few words
variables.description: Within each 500-word window, the share of content words (not function words) taken by the 10 most frequent ones, averaged.
variables.caveat: Needs at least 500 words (window size); blank for shorter stories.

variables.name: rep_bigram_repeat_share
variables.label: Repeated word pairs
variables.description: Within each 500-word window, the share of two-word sequences that occur more than once (ignoring pairs of function words), averaged.
variables.caveat: Needs at least 500 words (window size); blank for shorter stories.

variables.name: rep_trigram_repeat_share
variables.label: Repeated three-word phrases
variables.description: As above for three-word sequences.
variables.caveat: Needs at least 500 words (window size); blank for shorter stories.

variables.name: rep_adjacent_sentence_overlap
variables.label: Overlap between neighbouring sentences
variables.description: Average share of content words that consecutive sentences have in common (Jaccard overlap).

variables.name: rep_same_start_share
variables.label: Sentences starting the same way
variables.description: Share of sentences that start with the same word as the sentence before ('She… She… She…').

variables.name: rep_immediate_word_repeats_per_1k
variables.label: Doubled words
variables.description: Words immediately repeated ('yes, yes', 'oh oh') per 1,000 words.

variables.name: rep_repeated_5gram_per_1k
variables.label: Repeated five-word phrases
variables.description: Extra occurrences of any five-word sequence that appears more than once, per 1,000 words.

variables.name: style_profanity_per_1k
variables.label: Profanity
variables.description: Swear words per 1,000 words (lexicon).
variables.caveat: Overlaps with the sexual-action list for 'fuck'.

variables.name: style_all_caps_words_per_1k
variables.label: ALL-CAPS words
variables.description: Words written entirely in capitals (2+ letters, common acronyms excluded) per 1,000 words.

variables.name: style_ly_adverbs_per_1k
variables.label: -ly adverbs
variables.description: Words ending in -ly (excluding common non-adverbs like 'only', 'family', 'lovely') per 1,000 words.

variables.name: style_said_share
variables.label: Plain 'said' in dialogue tags
variables.description: 'said'/'says' as a share of all speech verbs (said, asked, whispered, moaned…).
variables.caveat: Blank when fewer than 5 speech verbs occur.

variables.name: style_action_verbs_per_1k
variables.label: Physical action verbs
variables.description: Verbs of physical movement (grab, pull, turn, reach…) per 1,000 words.

variables.name: style_descriptive_words_per_1k
variables.label: Descriptive words
variables.description: Descriptive adjectives and material words (beautiful, tall, slender, satin…) per 1,000 words.

variables.name: style_italics_per_1k
variables.label: Italics
variables.description: Italicised passages per 1,000 words.
variables.caveat: Italics are counted over the whole page body, author's notes included.

variables.name: sex_terms
variables.label: Sexual terms
variables.description: Number of sexual-language terms (all lists).
variables.caveat: A keyword count from editable word lists; it does not measure how explicit a story feels to a reader. Blank when the collected text is incomplete (text_truncated).

variables.name: has_text
variables.label: Text collected
variables.description: Whether story text was collected.

variables.name: text_truncated
variables.label: Text truncated
variables.description: Whether the story had more pages than were collected (page cap or missing pages).

variables.name: qc_text_too_short
variables.label: Text too short
variables.description: True when the text is shorter than the minimum for text measures (default 100 words).

variables.name: qc_english_function_word_share
variables.label: English function-word share
variables.description: Share of words that are common English function words; very low values suggest non-English text.

variables.name: qc_quote_style
variables.label: Quotation style
variables.description: Which quotation marks were treated as dialogue.

variables.name: qc_dialogue_quotes_unbalanced
variables.label: Unbalanced quotes
variables.description: More than half of the paragraphs with quotes have unmatched straight quotes, so dialogue measures are less reliable.

variables.name: qc_flags
variables.label: Quality flags
variables.description: List of data-quality flags for the story (see Methodology, 'Quality flags').

variables.name: analysis_include
variables.label: Included in analysis
variables.description: True when the story has text (≥ minimum words), a category, a publication date and a view count, is not a duplicate and looks like English.

variables.name: exclusion_reasons
variables.label: Exclusion reasons
variables.description: Why analysis_include is false (empty when included).

variables.name: tags
variables.label: Tags
variables.description: Tags the author attached (lower-case).
variables.caveat: In the Stage 2 handoff only tags used by at least 20 stories are kept (rare tags can contain names).
